[[File:StrongholdTerminal-SWTOR.png|thumb|A Stronghold directory terminal on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. The [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] writing on the screen says "Strongholds" and lower "purchase tours", advertising tours to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], to choose the most desirable property.]]
'''Stronghold directory terminals''' were self-service kiosks for acquiring real estate, widely used during the [[Inter-Sith Wars period]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] with real estate available for purchase through these terminals included capital worlds of [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]],<ref name="SWTOR GS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''</ref> planets of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] such as [[Mek-Sha]],<ref name="SWTOR O>''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref> and many other planets including [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]<ref name="SWTOR SoR>''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref> and [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]].<ref name="SWTOR KofET">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref> Major space hubs [[Vaiken Spacedock]] and [[Carrick Station]] had multiple stronghold directory terminals linked to the markets of different planets.<ref name="SWTOR GS" />

Types of real estate available for purchase varied from city apartments to farmsteads, [[Alderaan Noble Estate|castles]]<ref name="SWTOR GS" /> and moving trains.<ref name="SWTOR KofET" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stronghold directory terminals were introduced in the third Digital Expansion for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds|Galactic Strongholds]], as a way to purchase strongholds or preview those of other players.
